_comment: Assertions that are currently UNPROVEN for a known structural reason, with the
work that would make each runnable.
This exists to stop the gate from being permanently red, which is the failure
mode that matters: a check that is always failing is a check nobody reads, and
then a real regression arrives and nobody notices. With this baseline, a red run
It is deliberately not an ignore-list. The runner still reports every entry as
unproven, in the report and in the terminal, and it FAILS if a baselined
assertion starts passing — a baseline that outlives its reason is how these rot.
Removing the entry is part of the work that fixed it.
Nothing that is FAILING may be baselined. Only assertions that cannot be run at

unproven.reason: the app ships export but no import, so the round trip cannot be exercised
depends on the import path, which does not exist
schema_version 1 is the only version ever shipped, so there is no prior-version fixture to migrate from
unproven.runnable_when: the first LocalStore schema bump, which must ship a recorded v1 fixture alongside it

unproven.reason: screen-reader operability cannot be driven by automation
unproven.runnable_when: never automatically — a human runs NVDA, JAWS, or VoiceOver per the manual matrix in DOS-M09-008

unproven.reason: the Netlify static origin (digitaloilsticker.net) is not yet reachable — STATIC_ORIGIN is unset in CI and no deploy answers on the production hostname
unproven.runnable_when: DOS-M09-007 cuts digitaloilsticker.net DNS to Netlify team cDiscourse and provisions TLS, and STATIC_ORIGIN in CI points at the deploy

unproven.reason: depends on the Netlify static origin standing up; no pages exist to scan for third-party host references yet
unproven.runnable_when: DOS-M09-007 cuts digitaloilsticker.net DNS to Netlify team cDiscourse and provisions TLS, and the marketing/privacy/attribution/help/contact pages ship

unproven.reason: depends on the Netlify static origin standing up; the pages whose copy would be scanned do not yet ship
unproven.runnable_when: DOS-M09-007 cuts digitaloilsticker.net DNS to Netlify team cDiscourse and provisions TLS, and the static site's copy lands per the DOS-M02-003 spec

unproven.reason: depends on the Netlify static origin standing up; the attribution page cannot be compared against SOURCE_REGISTER.md until it exists (and no source is yet marked approved/published in the register)
